items.headline: According to TechCrunch, these involve proposals to raise approximately $50 billion at a valuation between $850 billion and $900 billion.
Google said earlier this month that it plans to invest up to $40 billion in Anthropic.

Alphabet committed an initial USD 10 billion in cash to Anthropic at a USD 350 billion valuation, with a further USD 30 billion tied to performance milestones. Amazon announced a separate commitment of up to USD 25 billion.

Four days earlier, Amazon announced a $5 billion investment into Anthropic, with up to $20 billion more tied to certain commercial milestones, building on the $8 billion Amazon had already invested, bringing its total commitment to $33 billion.
Google has announced a staggering investment of up to $40 billion in the AI startup Anthropic. This strategic financial commitment, unveiled on April 25, 2026.
The Seattle Group (Washington State) is planning to acquire, in the longer term, $20 billion in additional stock.
Alphabet, Google's parent company, could invest up to $40 billion in Anthropic start-up, according to press reports.
Earlier this month, Anthropic announced Mythos, which had the unprecedented capability to autonomously identify, at scale, hitherto undiscovered cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
On April 20, Amazon announced that it would invest up to an additional $25 billion in Anthropic and that it would bring its total commitment to $33 billion.

Artificial intelligence company Anthropic has agreed to commit more than $100 billion to Amazon's AWS cloud platform over the next 10 years to train and run its Claude chatbot. Amazon will invest $5 billion immediately as part of the new agreement announced this week by the companies, and up to another $20 billion in the future.

items.source_sentence: Amazon is investing $5 billion into Anthropic immediately, with the potential to invest up to $20 billion more tied to commercial milestones, meaning Amazon could put as much as $25 billion into the company in this round alone, on top of the $8 billion it had already invested since 2023.
In November 2025, Microsoft invested up to $5 billion in Anthropic and Anthropic committed to purchasing $30 billion of Azure compute capacity.
Amazon is now the first to receive $5 billion (and 4.2 billion) in the US.

Amazon will invest an additional $5 billion in Anthropic, expanding its financial and commercial relationship with the AI company and deepening Anthropic’s reliance on Amazon Web Services (AWS) for infrastructure.
The latest funding round shows that Anthropic’s valuation has ballooned 50% to $600 billion.

totals.note: Each matched deal record counts once, regardless of how many articles report it. Counts are measured over the entire filtered window, independent of result limits. USD amounts use fixed conversion rates, not current or transaction-date exchange rates. Only usable amounts enter sums, medians and maxima: finite, positive, converted to USD and at most 25,000,000,000 USD. Larger or unconverted figures are counted in deals_amount_excluded. Sums and medians count one company and amount once, because the same round is often reported under several round labels. Missing, zero, negative and non-finite amounts count as unknown; amount statistics are null when no matched deal has a usable amount. Deal records include equity rounds, debt facilities, placements and announced commitments. Amounts are reported figures, not independently verified financial amounts.
